long_description:
Karva Chauth – Mehndi Ki Raat 2026!!

Join us for Seattle’s most anticipated Karva Chauth – Mehndi Ki Raat 2026, an unforgettable evening dedicated to celebrating sisterhood, tradition, beauty, and togetherness.

Step into a vibrant celebration where culture meets elegance. Adorn your hands with beautiful mehndi, enjoy mesmerizing live entertainment, dance the night away with an energetic DJ, capture stunning memories at curated photo experiences, and celebrate with hundreds of women dressed in their festive best.

Indulge in an extraordinary culinary experience featuring signature flavors from Banaras, Delhi 6, Farzi Café, and Prom Curate, bringing together authentic Indian street food and contemporary favorites for one spectacular evening. 

Also check out other Food & Drink events in Bothell.
